title: A batch CR's card shows its batch folder, not its old 3-ready chip
summary: Specified bug fix, final: batch views (graph, Gantt, time cards, PRs) draw a batch CR's real folder (1-pending, 2-actives, 3-done) as a plain grey chip in place of the stale priority chip; server sends stage; docs updated; backlog and Kanban cards unchanged. Batch-30.
